cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Steer the Suspicion
cards.instruction: Hide your responsibility by redirecting every new clue toward a safer explanation before anyone can connect it back to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't pull that fallen shelf apart yet. The bracket they supplied is wrong; we need a photograph for the claim.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You put it upside down. The arrow points at the floor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That is a labeling fault until proven otherwise. Photograph it level, please. Not from above.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You drew that arrow. I watched you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then include the unmarked side. I had to supply their missing orientation mark. They can explain why that was my job.

heightening.evidence: A5 redirects B4's strongest evidence into a manufacturer omission while asking for another photograph.
